name: President of Uzbekistan
description: Head of state of the Republic of Uzbekistan; holds broad executive powers including appointing the government.

name: Presidential Administration of Uzbekistan
description: Information-analytical and organizational-control body supporting the President of Uzbekistan.

name: Cabinet of Ministers of Uzbekistan
description: Executive power body of Uzbekistan heading the system of state administration; accountable to the President and the Oliy Majlis.

name: Oliy Majlis (Supreme Assembly of Uzbekistan)
description: Bicameral parliament of Uzbekistan: Senate (100 seats) and Legislative Chamber (150 seats); founded 1994.

name: Senate of Uzbekistan
description: Upper house of the Oliy Majlis; 100 members (84 elected regionally, 16 appointed by the President).

name: Legislative Chamber of Uzbekistan
description: Lower house of the Oliy Majlis; 150 deputies elected for five-year terms.

name: Constitutional Court of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Supreme constitutional court of Uzbekistan; justices elected by the Senate.

name: Supreme Court of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Highest judicial body for civil, criminal and administrative cases in Uzbekistan.

name: Supreme Judicial Council of Uzbekistan
description: Body responsible for the selection and discipline of judges; its chief is elected by the Senate.

name: Prosecutor General's Office of Uzbekistan
description: Office of the Prosecutor General, the state prosecutorial agency of Uzbekistan.

name: Central Election Commission of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: State body administering elections and referendums in Uzbekistan.

name: Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Republic of Uzbekistan
aliases: Oʻzbekiston Respublikasi Iqtisodiyot va moliya vazirligi
description: Ministry responsible for budget, economic planning, tax and customs policy; oversees the Tax Committee and Customs Committee.

name: Ministry of Investment, Industry and Trade of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for investment attraction, industry and foreign trade; oversees investment attraction and export promotion agencies.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry conducting the foreign policy and diplomatic relations of Uzbekistan.

name: Ministry of Defense of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry exercising military administration; established by presidential decree on 2 July 1992.

relationships.target_name: Armed Forces of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry responsible for public order, police and crime prevention.

name: Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for legal policy, legislation and NGO registration.

name: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry organizing medical care and sanitary supervision; oversees the Center for Pharmaceutical Products Safety.

name: Ministry of Energy of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry responsible for electricity, gas and power supply policy.

name: Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for the agricultural sector and food supply; oversees veterinary and plant quarantine agencies.

name: Ministry of Water Resources of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for irrigation and management of the water fund.

name: Ministry of Digital Technologies of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for digitalization of the economy, IT industry and communications.

name: Ministry of Transport of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry regulating aviation, rail and road transport; also oversees state road bodies.

name: Ministry of Construction and Housing and Communal Services of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for construction, architecture and housing and communal services.

name: Ministry of Employment and Poverty Reduction of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for labor market regulation, employment and social support; oversees the Family and Women's Committee and the Mahalla and Entrepreneurship Agency.

name: Ministry of Preschool and School Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry managing the school and kindergarten system.

name: Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for higher education institutions, science and innovation policy.

name: Ministry of Culture of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for culture, cultural heritage protection and development of theaters.

name: Ministry of Sports of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for physical culture and sports development.

name: Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for fire prevention and response to natural disasters and emergencies.

name: Ministry of Mining Industry and Geology of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Ministry for subsoil exploration and mineral extraction policy.

name: Tax Committee under the Ministry of Economy and Finance
description: State committee responsible for tax administration.
parent_organization: Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Customs Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: State committee responsible for customs control.
parent_organization: Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: State Assets Management Agency (UzSAMA)
description: Government agency managing state-owned assets and enterprises and executing privatizations.

name: National Agency of Perspective Projects (NAPP)
description: Regulator of the Uzbek capital market, insurance sector and crypto assets.

name: National Committee on Ecology and Climate Change
description: State body for environmental protection, climate policy and ecological control.

name: Armed Forces of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Combined military forces of Uzbekistan, considered the strongest in Central Asia; founded 14 January 1992; about 120,000 active personnel (2025).

relationships.target_name: Uzbekistan Air and Air Defence Forces

name: Uzbek Ground Forces
description: Land warfare branch of the Uzbek military, organized into five military districts.
parent_organization: Armed Forces of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Uzbekistan Air and Air Defence Forces
description: Air warfare branch of the Uzbek military.
parent_organization: Armed Forces of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Uzbekistan National Guard
description: Uniformed independent elite formation within the Armed Forces of Uzbekistan.

name: State Security Service of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: National civilian intelligence and security agency of Uzbekistan; also oversees the Frontier (border) Service.

name: State Committee for Defense Industry of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Authorized state administration body for defense orders and defense production, created in November 2017; oversees enterprises such as Vostok, CHARZ, TexMash and RemTex.

name: Academy of the Armed Forces of Uzbekistan
description: Joint service academy training officers of all branches, established in 1994 under the University of Military Security and Defense.

name: Internal Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Uzbekistan
description: Militarized internal security force under the MIA, including Spetsnaz battalions such as Scorpion and Bars.
parent_organization: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Frontier Service of Uzbekistan
description: Border guard of Uzbekistan, operating under the National Security Service (State Security Service).
parent_organization: State Security Service of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Uzbekneftegaz
description: State-owned holding company of Uzbekistan's oil and gas industry, founded 1992.

name: Navoi Mining and Metallurgical Company (NMMC)
description: Large state-owned producer of gold, uranium and silver based in Navoiy; founded 1958; among the most profitable Uzbek SOEs.

name: Almalyk Mining and Metallurgical Combine (AGMK)
description: Major state-owned producer of copper and other metals; ranked among the most profitable Uzbek state-owned companies.

name: UzAuto Motors
description: State-owned automotive manufacturer based in Asaka; successor of GM Uzbekistan and UzDaewooAuto.

name: Uzbekistan Railways (Oʻzbekiston Temir Yoʻllari)
description: National railway company owning and managing all public rail infrastructure in Uzbekistan; founded 1994.

name: Uzbekistan Airways
description: Flag carrier airline of Uzbekistan, founded 1992, headquartered in Tashkent.

name: Uztransgaz
description: State company for gas transportation within Uzbekneftegaz group.

name: UzPost (Oʻzbekiston Pochtasi)
description: National postal operator of Uzbekistan, founded 1991.

name: Uzbek Commodity Exchange (UZEX)
description: Commodity exchange of Uzbekistan for wholesale trading of goods and resources.

name: Tashkent Mechanical Plant (TMZ)
description: High-technology enterprise in the aircraft industry.

name: Uzmetkombinat
description: Large steel and ferroalloys producer in Bekabad, founded 1944; long a leading state-owned company (partially privatized).

name: Farg'onaazot (Ferganaazot)
description: Major producer of chemicals and nitrogen fertilizers; among the most profitable state-owned companies.

name: Uzbekistan Airways Technics
description: Aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul enterprise; subsidiary of Uzbekistan Airways.

name: Artel Electronics
description: Leading Uzbek home appliance and electronics manufacturer, founded 2011.

name: AKFA Group
description: Uzbek industrial conglomerate active in construction materials, electronics and real estate.

name: Uzum
description: Uzbek e-commerce and fintech group (Uzum Market, Uzum Bank); ranked as the largest Uzbek company by revenue (~$2.4B, ZoomInfo 2026).

name: Korzinka
description: Largest supermarket chain in Uzbekistan.

name: Ucell
description: Mobile network operator in Uzbekistan (formerly Coscom).

name: Unitel (UMS)
description: Telecommunication company operating the UMS mobile network in Uzbekistan.

name: British American Tobacco Uzbekistan
description: Uzbek subsidiary of British American Tobacco, based in Tashkent.

name: Paynet
description: Electronic payment acceptance system operating in Uzbekistan.

name: Fergana Oil Refinery Plant
description: Oil refinery in Fergana region.

name: Indorama Agro
description: Agricultural company in Uzbekistan, part of Indorama Corporation group.

name: Click
description: Leading Uzbek digital payments startup; listed among top Uzbek startups by investment.

name: Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: National central bank of Uzbekistan, founded 1991; publishes statistics on commercial banks.

name: National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity of the Republic of Uzbekistan (NBU)
description: Largest bank in Uzbekistan by assets (139.9 trillion soums as of 1 March 2026); founded 25 October 1991, majority-owned by the government.

name: Uzbek Industrial and Construction Bank (SQB)
description: Joint-stock commercial bank founded 25 June 1991, government-owned; among the five largest banks (Fitch peer review).

name: Agrobank
description: State-owned joint-stock commercial bank focused on agribusiness; founded 2009.

name: Xalq Bank (People's Bank)
description: State-owned savings and retail bank founded 1993.

name: Asakabank
description: State-owned joint-stock bank founded 1996, historically serving the automotive industry.

name: Ipoteka Bank
description: Mortgage bank founded 2005; majority owned by OTP Bank (Hungary); among top banks by market capitalization (~$1.1B).

name: Kapitalbank
description: One of the largest private banks; ~61.5% owned by Uzum Group; founded 2001; ranked among top large banks (Frank.uz).

name: Ipak Yuli Bank
description: Private innovation commercial bank founded 1990.

name: Hamkorbank
description: Joint-stock bank with foreign capital founded 2000; among top large banks by assets (Frank.uz ranking).

name: TBC Bank Uzbekistan
description: Subsidiary of TBC Bank (Georgia), founded 2020; digital-focused bank.

name: Ziraat Bank Uzbekistan
description: Subsidiary of Ziraat Bank (Turkey), founded 1993.

name: Tenge Bank
description: Bank founded 2019; majority owned by Halyk Bank (Kazakhstan).

name: Business Development Bank (BDB)
description: State-owned development bank founded 2023 to support business development.

name: Uzum Bank
description: Digital bank founded 2021, part of Uzum Group.

name: National University of Uzbekistan named after Mirzo Ulugbek
description: Oldest and leading university of Uzbekistan, founded 1918; top-ranked in national rankings.

name: Samarkand State University
description: One of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Uzbekistan, founded 1927.

name: Tashkent State Technical University named after Islam Karimov
description: Major technical university founded 1920; ranked 1001-1200 in THE rankings.

name: Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi
description: Leading IT university founded 1955.

name: Tashkent State University of Economics
description: Major economics university founded 1931.

name: Tashkent State University of Law
description: Principal law university founded 1991.

name: University of World Economy and Diplomacy
description: Diplomatic academy founded 1992 under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

name: Westminster International University in Tashkent
description: British-style international university founded 2002.

name: Turin Polytechnic University in Tashkent
description: Branch of Politecnico di Torino founded 2009.

name: Inha University in Tashkent
description: Korean Inha University branch founded 2014.

name: Tashkent Institute of Irrigation and Agricultural Mechanization Engineers (TIIAME National Research University)
description: National research university for irrigation and agricultural engineering; entered QS world rankings.

name: Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan
description: National science academy coordinating the network of state research institutes.

name: Institute of Nuclear Physics
description: Nuclear physics research institute founded 1956, part of the Academy of Sciences.
parent_organization: Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Karakalpak State University
description: University of the Republic of Karakalpakstan founded 1976.

name: New Uzbekistan University
description: New flagship state-founded university in Tashkent established during higher education reform.

name: National Television and Radio Company of Uzbekistan (MTRK)
description: National state broadcaster operating the country's main TV and radio channels.

name: Uzbekistan National News Agency (UzA)
description: State-run national news agency publishing in nine languages; incorporates the Karakalpakstan Information Agency.

name: Dunyo Information Agency
description: News agency under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Uzbekistan.
parent_organization: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Kun.uz
description: Leading independent Uzbek-language news website.

name: Gazeta.uz
description: Major Uzbek news media outlet.

name: Daryo
description: Uzbek media covering Central Asia and Afghanistan, publishing in several languages.

name: UzReport
description: Private news agency and internet portal; also operates a TV channel.

name: The Tashkent Times
description: English-language news website in Uzbekistan.

name: Nuz.uz
description: Popular Russian-language news website in Uzbekistan.

name: Ozodlik Radiosi (Radio Ozodlik)
description: Uzbek-language service of Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty; publishes from outside the country; Tashkent bureau forced to close in 2005.

name: Halq Sozi
description: Uzbek-language national daily newspaper dominated by state control.

name: Pravda Vostoka
description: Russian-language state national daily newspaper.

name: National Association of Non-Governmental Non-Commercial Organizations of Uzbekistan (NANNOUz)
aliases: Oʻzbekiston nodavlat notijorat tashkilotlari milliy assotsiatsiyasi
description: One of the largest NGO umbrella organizations in the country, protecting NGOs' rights and fostering cooperation with government and international partners.

name: Youth Union of Uzbekistan / Youth Affairs Agency
description: State-organized youth body (formerly Youth Union, now Youth Affairs Agency under the government); cited among the largest civil-society structures with ~20 branches.

name: Mahalla Public Charitable Foundation
description: National charitable foundation operating through mahalla (neighborhood) structures; one of the largest civil-society organizations.

name: Uzbekistan Football Association (UFA)
description: Football governing body of Uzbekistan, a nonprofit organization.

name: Women's Committee of Uzbekistan
description: State-supported committee for family and women's issues, under the Ministry of Employment and Poverty Reduction.
parent_organization: Ministry of Employment and Poverty Reduction of the Republic of Uzbekistan

name: Ecoforum of NGOs of Uzbekistan
description: Coalition of non-governmental environmental organizations in Uzbekistan.

name: Center for Progressive Reforms
description: Nonprofit organization in Tashkent focused on policy analysis and reforms.

name: Uzbek Forum for Human Rights
description: International human rights NGO monitoring labor and human rights in Uzbekistan's cotton sector; advocated with the UN alongside Cotton Campaign.

name: Uzbekistan Liberal Democratic Party (UzLiDeP)
description: Ruling centre-right economic liberalist party founded 2003; largest faction in the Legislative Chamber (64 seats after 2024 election).

key_people.title: Party Leader / Chairman of Executive Committee
key_people.name: Abdulla Aripov

name: Uzbekistan National Revival Democratic Party (Milliy Tiklanish)
description: Right-wing national conservative party founded 1995; 29 seats in the Legislative Chamber.

name: Justice Social Democratic Party (Adolat)
description: Centre-left social democratic party founded 1995; ~21 seats in the Legislative Chamber.

name: People's Democratic Party of Uzbekistan (XDP)
description: Centrist party founded 1991, successor to the Communist Party of the Uzbek SSR; ~20 seats in the Legislative Chamber.

name: Ecological Party of Uzbekistan
description: Left-wing green politics party founded 2008 (successor of the Ecological Movement); ~16 seats in the Legislative Chamber.

name: Erk Democratic Party (Liberty Democratic Party)
description: Opposition party banned in Uzbekistan, operating in exile; historic leader Muhammad Salih.

name: Birdamlik People's Democratic Movement
description: Opposition political organisation operating from outside Uzbekistan.

name: Social Democratic Party "Truth and Progress"
description: Political party in Uzbekistan.

name: Interstate Commission for Water Coordination of Central Asia (ICWC)
description: Interstate body coordinating water resources among Central Asian states; headquartered in Tashkent.

name: International Fund for Saving the Aral Sea (IFAS)
description: Intergovernmental fund established by Central Asian states to mitigate the Aral Sea crisis; its Executive Committee works in Tashkent.
